field_text: Spool erection and field fit-up successfully finished at Manifold A today.
Completed right of way ROW clearing, grubbing & grading for Section B pipeline route.
100% NDT radiography testing carried out on all 12 weld joints at KP 16 to 30.
High tension HT cable pulling and routing completed across Feeder C.
Dial gauge cold and hot alignment of compressor motor shaft finalized in Shed A.
Reinforcement steel bar rebar cutting, bending and fixing done for Foundation B.
Horizontal directional drilling HDD river crossing pulled through at Crossing C.
Golden tie-in welding at existing header connection completed at Manifold D.
Bench calibration of pressure and temperature transmitters completed for Batch A.
Installation of 33kV/415V main stepdown transformer completed in Substation A.
Trench padding, backfilling and soil compaction completed KP 31 to 45 Section C.
Dyke bund wall civil construction around crude storage Tank B finished up to 2m height.
Emergency shutdown valve ESDV stroke testing and calibration carried out at Station D.
Flare knockout drum KOD skidded vessel erection placed on foundation at Area B.
Piping spool prefabrication at field workshop Manifold C 42 joints welded.
Hydrotesting done today on line 3 section B, holding 95 bar pressure.
Lowering work completed today for pipeline near river bank area.
PCC layer poured for main compressor block, curing initiated.
Cable tray fixing and cable laying ongoing along the overhead pipe rack.
Chemical copper earthing pit digging and backfilling with compound completed.
Golden tie-in joint welded at header junction, visual check passed.
Valve pit wall concrete casted today, 18 cum consumed.
Gas compressor skid positioned on foundation bolts with 50 ton crane.
DCS instrument signal checking in progress with control room engineer.
Flange bolt torquing and tensioning inspection completed on main skid.
Stringing of 14-inch coated pipes done for 85 joints along right of way.
Non-shrink epoxy grouting poured below dispatch pump baseplate.
RTU panel installed and terminal wiring connected in local shelter.
Pigging run tool launched and retrieved successfully with zero damage to cup.
Formwork and water curing of concrete block completed, 14 days finished.
Continuous heavy torrential rain since 9 AM, site completely waterlogged, civil work suspended.
Daily safety toolbox meeting conducted with 45 workers regarding working at height and PPE.
Site DG generator 250 kVA fuel tank filled with 800 liters diesel, oil filter replaced.
Local village panchayat delegation visited site regarding culvert crossing access road.
Hydraulic excavator CAT 320 broken down due to blown oil hose, mechanic team dispatched.
Catering and drinking water delivery received for night shift crew.
Third party ISO audit team completed documentation review in admin building.
Forest department ranger conducted joint boundary pillar verification.
Site perimeter floodlights bulb replacement completed on Mast 4.
Scaffolding dismantled from administrative building stairwell.
